name: Shiplet v. Vilsack, Secretary of Agriculture

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: Shiplet v. Vilsack, Secretary of Agriculture.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of certiorari with supplemental appendix under seal denied without prejudice to filing a renewed motion together with either a redacted supplemental appendix or an explanation as to why the supplemental appendix may not be redacted within 30 days.
